segments.speaker: unknown
segments.text: Nura will listen now. Nura keeps what you and Dr Tan say. Only you and those you let in can hear it. Is that OK, Dr Tan?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Good morning. Your blood pressure book shows the morning numbers drifting up. Last week 138 over 84, this week 142 over 88.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: From Friday I want you to take the full water pill in the morning instead of half. Keep the blood pressure tablet as it is.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Every morning, before breakfast, stand on the scale and write the number in the book.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: We will do a blood test on Monday 28 September. Nothing to eat after midnight the night before, water is fine.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: I will see you again on Thursday 15 October at ten in the morning. Bring the book.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Thank you, doctor. Is the water pill bad for my kidneys?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: No. We will check your kidneys with the blood test.

segments.speaker: family
segments.text: I will bring the book on the day.
